title: A CARRIED BALLOT IS PAID IN FULL UNLESS THE SEASON'S OWN MEASUREMENT CONTRADICTS IT. `drep` is a career reputation decayed 15%/yr in BOTH directions, so a season with no ballot of its own collects a neighbouring year's selection at full weight in the PD composite. The carried share of that term is now discounted toward CARRIED_REIN 0.50 only where the season's own regressed tracked perimeter read falls below the window where the carried class's p05 (49.2) and the certified class's p01 (49.3) meet, full credit at 51.7. Mikal Bridges '21 perdef 95 -> 81, DEF 91 -> 81; Jrue Holiday '20, Marcus Smart '23 and Kobe Bryant '99 are BYTE-IDENTICAL, which is his second ruling; recal_141's control pin Mikal Bridges '24 holds at exactly 78

notes: THE SUBJECT, MEASURED. Mikal Bridges '21 read perdef 95, #4 of 2021 behind Draymond '99, Smart '98 and Jrue '96, on a season with NO 2021 ballot: his drep 0.85 is his 2022 All-Defensive 1st team decayed one year, and the PD composite paid it at the full wing rate (0.453 x 1.2 x 0.85 = 0.462 of a 0.959 sheet, 48% of the card). DBPM +0.9, STL% 1.6, and the worst tracked read of any card in the file printing 95+: +5.3% on 483 shots defended from 6ft out and +2.8% on 863 overall.

WHY THE SEPARATOR IS THE SEASON'S OWN MEASUREMENT AND NOT THE CARRY, MEASURED ON THE POOL. The flat half-rate on every carried ballot lands the subject exactly (95 -> 80) and is the form his second ruling forbids: run on the whole file it moves 1,147 cards, every one of them down, and takes Jrue Holiday '20 95 -> 80 (-15), Marcus Smart '23 95 -> 78 (-17), Kobe Bryant '99 91 -> 77 (-14), Kobe '05 90 -> 74, Luguentz Dort '24 91 -> 74, Avery Bradley '15 92 -> 73, Herbert Jones '22 94 -> 74 — and recal_141's control pin Mikal Bridges '24 78 -> 63. The carry DISTANCE separates them the wrong way round — Bridges '21 carries one year, his '24 carries two — so distance cannot be the discriminator either (and recal_158, which used it, was declined).

WHAT DOES SEPARATE THEM, in card space on the file's own regressed tracked line: Bridges '21 47.3 · Bridges '20 48.0 · Bridges '25 53.8 · Bridges '23 55.5 · Smart '23 56.3 · Bridges '24 56.9 · Dort '26 59.9 · Bradley '15 59.8 · PG '17 63.4 · Jrue '20 63.5 · Dort '24 63.8 · Amen '26 65.5 · Roberson '15 65.6 · Herbert Jones '23 67.0. The subject and his '20 are the only two of the class below the window, and they are 1.9 and 1.2 points below it. Kobe '99 and every other pre-2014 carry is not measured at all and is therefore paid in full.
